what: crates/hir-ty/Cargo.toml: add `[target.'cfg(blaze_check)'.dependencies]` with `blaze-check.workspace = true` (as crates/blaze-reclaim/Cargo.toml:16-17). Why: crates/hir-ty/src/method_resolution/pick_cache/table.rs (the lock-free pick and steps cache) now takes its atomics and Mutex from blaze_check::sync under cfg(blaze_check), and its model test pick_cache/table/model.rs (docs/v2/plan/design/unsafe.md, model checking of every lock-free structure) runs there. Without it hir-ty fails to build only under --cfg blaze_check; normal builds are unaffected.
